name: deepwater-developer
description: Spec-driven feature delivery for Java/Spring applications that expose one use-case model through MCP, REST, GraphQL and AG-UI adapters. Works in any repository: tickets come from GitHub, GitLab or pasted text, and project settings live in the repository (docs/delivery/repository-mapping.md, created by /deepwater-developer:init). Adds /deepwater-developer:init, :feature, :spec, :dod and the spec-driven-feature agent.
